clauses.text: Fuel exhaustion is uncatchable. When the fuel of 6.7 runs out, the run or the event ends in trap("comptime fuel exhausted"), whatever encloses the operation: a `with budget n ... else [as e]` block (at any n, even one not yet reached), a `par` branch, or a spawned task. No Else block runs, nothing after the exhausting operation is emitted, and the outcome is the same on every schedule.
